desc:
A handoff from sales chat to your team passes a conversation from the assistant to a real person, with the full history attached. Ecom Swift LLC sets the rules, alerts and messages, so warm leads reach the right person at the right moment.

## What is a handoff to sales?

A handoff to sales is the point where your chat assistant stops answering and a person takes over. The shopper is told what is happening, and the team member receives the conversation, the products the shopper viewed and what they said they want.

A good handoff feels like being passed to a colleague who already knows your question. A bad one feels like starting again, and shoppers rarely repeat themselves patiently.

## When should an assistant pass a chat to a person?

An assistant should hand off whenever a human judgment would help more than a quick answer. Typical triggers include a large order, a custom request, a complaint, a question the assistant cannot answer, a shopper who asks for a person and buying signals that deserve a personal touch.

Without clear rules, the assistant either keeps going when it should step aside or escalates everything and floods your team. Defining the triggers keeps your people for the conversations that need them.

## How a good handoff affects lead quality and response time

The first benefit is speed. Your team sees the alert with the whole context at once, so the first human reply can be specific and useful. The second is continuity, because the shopper does not repeat what they already said. The third is fairness, since routing sends each topic to the person best suited to it.

During working hours the shopper can join a live conversation. Outside those hours the assistant collects contact details and states a reply time you set, so nobody is left staring at a silent window. The outcome still depends on how quickly and well your team responds, which is why we also report response times.

## What a good handoff setup includes

- Clear triggers for when the assistant passes a chat on.
- An alert by email, with the history, to the right person.
- Products viewed and pages visited shown to the team member.
- A message telling the shopper what happens next.
- Live handoff in working hours.
- An out of hours message with a short form.
- Routing by topic, product or team member.
- Alerts in Slack or your inbox, according to your habit.
- A response time report.
- Written scripts for common handoff situations.

## How we set it up

We begin with a conversation about your team: who is online when, who handles what and what a valuable lead looks like. We turn this into written rules.

Then we build the triggers, connect the alerts and write the messages the shopper sees. We test with sample chats that include a large order, an angry customer and a late night enquiry, checking who gets alerted and what the shopper reads. Basic handles handoff by email. Standard adds live chat during working hours and an out of hours route. Premium adds routing across more team members, alerts in your chosen tool, a response time report and a period of rule changes.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Tell shoppers plainly when a person is joining.
- Set a realistic reply time for out of hours chats.
- Give each team member a short guide to using the alerts.
- Review handed off chats weekly and adjust the rules.
- Keep one named person responsible for unrouted chats.

**Avoid:**
- Handing off every chat, which defeats the purpose.
- Promising instant replies when no one is online.
- Hiding the option to speak with a person.
- Sending alerts to a shared inbox that nobody watches.
- Skipping a test of the out of hours path.

## Who this is for

This fits a store that sells higher priced or custom items where buyers want reassurance from a person. It suits a company with a small sales team that wants to spend time only on serious leads. It also suits a business that sees enquiries at all hours and needs the first reply handled gracefully.

## What we need from you

Tell us who should receive handoffs, your working hours, the topics that need a person and the tools your team already uses for alerts. Share any wording you prefer for the shopper messages.

We work inside your own accounts and never need a password. Access is given as a team member, collaborator or developer user where supported, and you can remove it whenever you like. After you order, we send a checklist and keep you informed until the first real handoff goes through.
